courses.title: Practical AI for Consulting Teams
courses.description: Practical AI for Consulting Teams takes you from the basics of artificial intelligence for consulting to applying it on a realistic Consulting Director scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to stakeholder communication, enough to use it alongside artificial intelligence for consulting day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying artificial intelligence for consulting to a real Consulting Director scenario
Practicing artificial intelligence for consulting through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to stakeholder communication
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Client Relationship Management in Practice
courses.description: Client Relationship Management in Practice is a focused course on client relationship management for people already working toward a Consulting Director role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying client relationship management on your own.
